title: Комментарии к таблице
setup:
CREATE TABLE person_discounts (
    id bigint PRIMARY KEY,
    person_id bigint,
    pizzeria_id bigint,
    discount numeric,
    CONSTRAINT fk_person_discounts_person_id FOREIGN KEY (person_id) REFERENCES person (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_person_discounts_pizzeria_id FOREIGN KEY (pizzeria_id) REFERENCES pizzeria (id)
);
verify: SELECT 'table' AS what, COALESCE(length(trim(obj_description(to_regclass('person_discounts'), 'pg_class'))) > 0, false) AS has_comment UNION ALL SELECT a.attname::text, COALESCE(length(trim(col_description(a.attrelid, a.attnum))) > 0, false) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid = to_regclass('person_discounts') AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped ORDER BY 1
